Summary

This is not a standalone PoC script but the actual local-mcp MCP server codebase, whose exec tool contains the real CVE-2026-6130 bypass: a workaround using a generated batch file plus base64 encoding that circumvents intended command-execution restrictions within the tool’s sandboxing logic, allowing execution of commands that the restriction mechanism was meant to block.
